#+TITLE: 49 make.room.decouple — `git clone dot-emacs` gives cli + room + tmux sessions, no cluster checkout
#+STARTUP: overview

* Dev process setup
  Before executing ANY work item in this plan, open and obey
  the rules defined in this project's per-repo instructions:

    - .github/copilot-instructions.md  (mirrored in CLAUDE.md)

  Both auto-load into every GHCP CLI session.  Read the current
  rules there and follow them.  This plan intentionally does
  not restate any rule — the per-repo instructions are the
  single source of truth.

* Execution environment
  This plan runs on a multi-machine environment described in:

    - ${FLEET_HOME:-$HOME/.fleet}/cluster.md

  Read it before executing.  Where it defines parallelism, it
  outranks subagent fan-out.  This plan does not restate it.

* WHY THIS PLAN EXISTS
  :USER_VERBATIM_2026-09-28: see the twin, cluster
    .github/REPL/49.room.cli.portable.org.txt (same words, both halves).
  Split (user ruling _b "one on dot-emacs repo, another on cluster repo"):
  - cluster 49 owns the CODE: portable cli/room, export + manifest, the
    quoting fix (Phase A, Phase Q).
  - dot-emacs 49 (this doc) owns DELIVERY: vendor the export, install from
    a clone, test in clean ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04 containers, re-pack the
    bundles, and a monitor that reviews every commit of the swarm.
  Swarm roles (user: "one change, one pack, one test, one review/monitor"):
  | role    | task(s)            | repo      | box (odsp)       |
  |---------+--------------------+-----------+------------------|
  | change  | cluster A, Q       | cluster   | dispatcher picks |
  | test    | T.24, T.26         | dot-emacs | c06, c07         |
  | pack    | P                  | dot-emacs | c08 (or here)    |
  | monitor | M (runs whole time)| dot-emacs | c17 / this box   |

* Goal [0/4]
  - [ ] G1 in a clean ubuntu:24.04 AND ubuntu:26.04 container (host network,
        ~/.ssh + ~/.fleet read-only, NO /workspace/cluster):
        `git clone dot-emacs && install/fleet/install.sh` -> `cli -r` lists
        the fleet, `room -c session_top read` works, `room next` gates.
  - [ ] G2 install/fleet/ is byte-identical to a cluster export
        (MANIFEST check rc 0); install/cli is gone (one copy, not two).
  - [ ] G3 both bundles carry install/fleet, built + archived.
  - [ ] G4 monitor M reviewed every commit of the swarm; issues it posted
        are closed or ruled.

* Design record  (49-D1..D4 live in the cluster twin)
  - :49-D5: install.sh is idempotent and local-only: symlinks
    ~/local/bin/{cli,room} -> install/fleet/{cli-sessions.sh,room.sh},
    links install/fleet/skills/room into ~/.copilot/skills/room if absent,
    prints what ~/.fleet lacks.  It never writes ~/.fleet (49-D2).
  - :49-D6: fleet-shell.sh keeps preferring a LIVE /workspace/cluster
    checkout; falls back to install/fleet (so cluster edits still land
    on cluster boxes first).
  - :49-D7: test containers are throwaway `docker run --rm --network host`
    (49-F3); no image is built for the test, only the bundle build (P).

* Dependencies
  - cluster 49 task A done (export exists) before D.1.
  - room group session_top; tasks carry needs {"tier":"wsl","island":"odsp"}.
